HOTEL DALE
CAPE MAY, NEW JERSEY

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: This magnificent four-story structure, with every modern convenience, has just been completed at a cost of $50,000.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: one of the hotel is the beautiful grill room. The management has engaged the full Abyssinian Orchestra to render afternoon and evening concerts in the room daily during the entire season.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: It is, without exception, the finest and most complete hostelry in the United States for the accommodation of our race.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The open-air amusements available to the guests are numerous. The lawn of the hotel contains both croquet and tennis courts.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: It is located on the highest elevation in the heart of the residence portion of cool Cape May.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The sea bathing at Cape May is unsurpassed on the Atlantic Ocean. It is remarkable for its fine surf and is perfectly safe at all times for women and children. The hotel has its own private bath houses.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The view from the hotel is magnificent; on the front, overlooking overlooking the celebrated golf links, the vista stretches away to take in the beautiful driveways and farms of the inland section of the Cape. The rear commands an extensive view of the harbor and sea. The invigorating ocean breezes reach every section of the hotel.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The sailing and fishing in the harbor and adjacent sounds are always attractive and boats may be had at all times.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The interior of this hotel may be described as the acme of luxury, comfort and elegance.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The hotel is under the personal management of the owner, E. W. Dale, one of the most progressive and successful business men of our race. His experience as a hotel man has enabled him to use his very thorough knowledge of details in bringing the equipment of his hotel to perfection.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: The Hotel Dale contains one hundred light, airy and luxuriously furnished rooms with every modern convenience. Electric lights throughout the entire house. Suites with bath and long distance telephone connections. The elegantly furnished dining room is operated under both European and American plans. The cuisine will contain all the delicacies of the season, prepared by a master of the culinary art. Sea foods a specialty.

regions.label: plain_text
regions.text: This hotel is easy of access from the stations of either the Pennsylvania or the Reading Railroad. Literature and additional information will be mailed upon request.
